text:
emma: Quick check — we need a concise hero + top form flow for the launch pages. Goal: convert dev trial signups and pre-reg for enterprise. Thinking separate lead paths for Hosted (time-to-value), Dedicated (throughput/SLA), Private (compliance).

olivia: Love the split. Can we try a single hero with dynamic subhead copy per mode? Example headline: "Ship LLM features in minutes" then subhead changes: Hosted -> "Start in 5 minutes via API", Dedicated -> "Predictable throughput for production", Private -> "Deploy in your VPC with audit logs" :thinking_face:

raj: Agreed. For routing, map form submissions to different lead queues: hosted -> product-led SDR; dedicated -> enterprise AE; private -> security sales. Also add checkbox on form 'I want deployment help' to surface enterprise leads.

zach: We should surface 2 quick benchmarks near the hero: tokens/sec and 99th latency for sample model. Use human-readable: "~500 req/s with 20ms p99 (small model)" plus a link to benchmark page. Avoid raw numbers that vary by model.

mia: For A/B we can test 'short form vs email-only' and 'hero with benchmark vs hero without'. Primary metric: trial signups/week; secondary: MQL conversion within 14 days. I'll set up analytics tags.

emma: Love it. One copy ask: we need microcopy for the CTA variants. Options: "Start Free" / "Request Dedicated Trial" / "Schedule Private Demo". Any other phrasing ideas?

olivia: Maybe keep Hosted CTA action-forward: "Create API Key". Dedicated: "Reserve Capacity". Private: "Request On‑Prem Checklist". Short and specific.

raj: Also add a small webhook on submit that sets lead_source=hero_mode and campaign=launch_webinar. That makes routing + nurture easier.

 devops-bot: deploy note: staging pages updated at 2026-03-20 22:10 UTC, assets baked. CI diff: /marketing/landing/hero-variants

zach: Add trust badges: SOC2, VPC, GPU partners. One-liners under badges: "SLA-backed" / "Private networking" / "Multi-GPU scale".

mia: I'll push a GA4 event schema: hero_click, form_submit, mode_checkbox, cta_variant. Will share in #analytics later.

emma: Action items: 1) olivia to draft hero variants + CTAs 2) raj to map form routing + webhook 3) mia to configure A/B tests + events 4) zach to pick benchmarks + badges 5) design to handoff assets by EOD Thursday. Anyone object?

olivia: On it — will post Figma frames by tomorrow morning.

raj: I'll draft routing doc and webhook payload example.

zach: I'll prepare benchmark copy and link to detailed page.

mia: Setting up experiment, targeting 50/50 split for two weeks.

emma: Great, thanks team :rocket:
